title: Inventory tooltip covers item name
description: When I hover over an inventory item, the tooltip opens on top of its name. I have to move the cursor away to read the label.

title: Settings text clipped at small resolution
description: Several options at the bottom of the settings panel are cut off when I switch to a smaller display resolution.

title: Health bar extends beyond screen edge
description: Increasing the interface scale pushes the health bar beyond the right edge of the screen during gameplay.

title: Confirm button has no focus indicator
description: I can move between the confirmation buttons using a controller, but neither button shows which one currently has focus.

title: Quest marker remains on completed objective
description: The objective is marked as complete in the quest log, but its marker is still on the map afterward.

title: Pause menu overlaps subtitle text
description: If I pause while subtitles are visible, the pause panel covers part of the dialogue text.

title: Scrollbar disappears in long menu
description: The menu list scrolls normally, although its scrollbar disappears once the number of entries gets large.

title: Keybinding label shows old shortcut
description: After I change an action's key binding, the controls page still displays the previous shortcut.

title: Jump input ignored near ledge
description: Jump sometimes fails to register when the character is standing close to the edge of a platform.

title: Crafting consumes materials without item
description: The crafting action removes the required materials from the inventory, but the finished item never appears.

title: Checkpoint does not update
description: I activate the newest checkpoint and restart the level, yet the character respawns at the earlier checkpoint.

title: Interaction prompt works outside range
description: An interactable object can still be triggered when the player is well beyond the distance where its prompt disappears.

title: Quest progress does not advance
description: The quest asks me to defeat several enemies. The counter stays unchanged even after the required targets are defeated.

title: Door collision remains after opening
description: The door opens visually after being unlocked, but the character hits an invisible barrier when trying to walk through.

title: Item duplicates after moving inventory slot
description: Moving the same item back and forth between inventory slots occasionally creates an additional copy.

title: Save load resets equipped weapon
description: After saving with a different weapon equipped, reloading restores the default weapon instead of the selected one.

title: Frame rate drops in crowded area
description: The game runs smoothly in quieter areas, then suffers a noticeable frame rate drop when many characters enter view.

title: Loading screen stalls after fast travel
description: After several fast travel attempts, the loading screen stays visible much longer than it did at the start of the session.

title: Memory usage grows after opening map
description: Memory use keeps increasing whenever I open and close the map, and it does not return to its earlier level.

title: Menu transition causes long freeze
description: Switching rapidly between inventory and settings sometimes leaves the game unresponsive for a few seconds.

title: Texture streaming causes stutter
description: Quick camera turns in a newly entered area cause brief pauses while the environment textures appear.

title: Shadows setting takes unusually long to apply
description: Changing shadow quality during gameplay makes the application freeze momentarily before the new setting takes effect.

title: Autosave produces repeated hitch
description: Every time autosave starts, movement briefly stutters even though the player is not entering a new area.

title: Long session causes rising input delay
description: After a long session, movement begins responding later than usual to the same keyboard inputs.

title: Lobby player count differs across clients
description: One player's lobby screen shows a different number of connected players from the count shown by the host.

title: Client disconnects when host changes scene
description: A joined player is unexpectedly disconnected when the host moves the group to another scene.

title: Chat messages arrive out of order
description: Messages sent in quick succession by two players occasionally appear in a different order on their chat panels.

title: Reconnection does not restore session
description: After a short connection loss, reconnecting sends the player to the main menu rather than the active match.

title: Ready status fails to synchronize
description: The local ready indicator changes correctly, but another player's lobby screen continues to show the old status.

title: Matchmaking remains stuck after cancellation
description: Cancelling a matchmaking search and starting another leaves the second search spinning without progressing.

title: High latency warning missing
description: During severe simulated latency, the game continues without displaying any connection quality warning.

title: Remote player position stops updating
description: A remote character stops moving on screen for several seconds and then suddenly jumps to a new position.

title: Background music stops after pause
description: The background track falls silent after I open the pause menu and resume the game.

title: Dialogue audio missing in cutscene
description: The cutscene advances and subtitles appear, but the characters' spoken dialogue cannot be heard.

title: Sound effects play twice on interaction
description: Interacting with the door once triggers the same sound effect twice in immediate succession.

title: Voice volume slider has no effect
description: Changing the voice volume slider does not seem to affect the loudness of dialogue playback.

title: Footstep sounds continue after stopping
description: Footstep sounds continue for a short time after the character has stopped and movement input has been released.

title: Audio channel balance shifts unexpectedly
description: After moving from the menu into gameplay, most sound seems to come from one headphone channel.

title: Environmental sound disappears after reload
description: An ambient sound source is audible before saving, but its audio disappears after loading that save.

title: Notification sound ignores mute setting
description: The notification tone still plays even after sound effects have been muted in the audio settings.
